notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 28th

[*] Angle of disc trajectory now requires a more precise range
[*] Drag impacts disc through angular and linear dampening

[*] Pause Menu now allows for restarting the current level

[*] Additional controls not complete have been removed (i.e. switching disc hands, disabling HUD, etc.)
[*] Changing discs now updates on the HUD
[*] Removed 'Gimme Spot' which finished a hole adding a stroke assuming next shot would be made
[*] Improved basket catching/registering
[*] Corrected Fast Travel system to work more appropriately
[*] General optimization of disc and player
[*] Added basic tutorial to demonstrate throwing
[*] Improved throwing animation of backhand throw
[/list]
